description.en: Babica Micka's words for every day, in the kitchen, in the village and at the table: to be, to go, to have, to come, to see, to say and to tell, to give, to sleep; good and well, big and new; so, how, already, now, then, only, also, a lot; please, thank you and the morning.
description.de: Babica Mickas Wörter für jeden Tag, in der Küche, im Dorf und am Tisch: sein, gehen, haben, kommen, sehen, sagen und erzählen, geben, schlafen; gut, groß und neu; so, wie, schon, jetzt, dann, nur, auch, viel; bitte, danke und der Morgen.
description.it: Le parole di ogni giorno di Babica Micka, in cucina, in paese e a tavola: essere, andare, avere, venire, vedere, dire e raccontare, dare, dormire; buono e bene, grande e nuovo; così, come, già, adesso, poi, solo, anche, molto; per favore, grazie e la mattina.
